title: Property
description: design/developers/plugin_model.md §3 (Property object): defines one property of a NodeDef (nodedef.schema.json). Restructured from iox-vscode-plugin's node.properties.schema.json, which models `editor` as an INLINE editor definition (`$ref editor.schema.json` in the ioxplugin sense) and additionally requires an `is_settable` boolean. Dynamic Profiles has neither: `editor` is a plain id STRING referencing the top-level `editors` array (confirmed in src/nucore/profile.py: `eid = pdict["editor"]; editor = get_editor(eid)`), and there is no `is_settable` concept in the spec -- both changes carried through here. `parent` (present in the source's common.node.schema.json) is also dropped: it is a live-instance/runtime concept in nucore (NodeBase.parent), not part of a catalog-side Property. `name` is optional here even though the spec table has no '(Optional)' marker on it -- src/nucore/profile.py reads it via `pdict.get("name")`, and the existing test fixture (tests/unified/dev_tools/test_profile_authoring.py's VALID_PROFILE) omits it -- see schemas/README.md's leniency-policy note.

editor.description: Editor ID -- a reference into the top-level `editors` array, not an inline editor definition.

hide.description: If true, property is hidden in UI.
